Fact: eval_methodology
What to find: How evaluations were run (harness, settings, prompts, shots).
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Methodology

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Evaluation was conducted with VLMEvalkit. To enable Thinking mode, set the system prompt to R1_SYSTEM_PROMPT, with do_sample=True and temperature=0.6 recommended to mitigate repetition. Reported paper results are obtained without test-time scaling unless otherwise specified.
quotes: > We conduct the evaluation with [VLMEvalkit](https://github.com/open-compass/VLMEvalKit). ***To enable the Thinking mode of our model, please set the system prompt to [R1_SYSTEM_PROMPT](https://github.com/open-compass/VLMEvalKit/blob/main/vlmeval/vlm/internvl/internvl_chat.py#L38).*** When enabling Thinking mode, we recommend setting `do_sample=True` and `temperature=0.6` to mitigate undesired repetition.
> Notably, unless otherwise specified, the experimental results reported in our paper are obtained without applying TTS.
